en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a seaside scene with several sailing boats moored along a stone quay. A wooden villa stands on a small rise behind the quay, with trees and shrubs around it and a tall chimney with smoke in the background. A flagpole flies what appears to be a Scandinavian flag. On the right, a path leads uphill where two people in early 20th‑century clothing are walking. Printed text appears at the bottom, along with a short handwritten note.
